in_marathi.name: Eswari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eswari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eswari is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Eeshwara', which means 'Lord of the Universe'. This name is believed to be a form of the goddess Lakshmi, who is the deity of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology. Eswari is revered for her abundant blessings and is often invoked for financial success and material prosperity.
